convention: AL gradient = d(admm_objective)/d(es_pnet[y,d,p]) via Pyomo exact symbolic differentiation, evaluated at the pickled (converged) point. EPS gradient = EPS_ESSO_THROUGHPUT (constant; the throughput regularization term is linear in pch/pdch). Both are gradients w.r.t. the same physical quantity (a cohort pch/pdch, since d(es_pnet)/d(pch) = 1 for an active cohort).
